description: This file defines macros and inline functions for a generic, type-safe vector implementation in C, including functions for initialization, allocation, clearing, freeing, reserving space, pushing, and popping elements, utilizing external functions for memory management and assertions.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_init
methods.description: Initializes a vector structure by setting data pointer to NULL and size/count to zero.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new vector structure.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_clear
methods.description: Clears the vector, optionally releasing each element if a release function is provided, then reinitializes the vector.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_free
methods.description: Frees the vector structure and its data, after clearing.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_reserve
methods.description: Reserves additional space in the vector to accommodate at least p more elements.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_push
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector, resizing if needed.

methods.name: vector_vector_name_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the vector, asserting that it is not empty.
